title: Citizenship in Kenya
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts from the 2010 Constitution (to confirm by the teacher): citizenship by birth and by registration (marriage after seven years, lawful residence for seven years); dual citizenship allowed.

skills.key_step: The child says a person is a Kenyan citizen by birth or by registration, and that the ID card or passport shows citizenship but does not make it.

floor.prerequisite: Names qualities of a good citizen in school.
floor.question: Give one quality of a good citizen.

representations: two boxes: by birth and by registration
a photo of an ID card
steps: Ask: was the person born a citizen?
contexts: a baby born in Kitui to Kenyan parents
a woman who married a Kenyan and registered after seven years
a child born abroad to a Kenyan father

board.do: Draw two boxes: by birth, by registration.

board.say: A baby is born abroad to a Kenyan mother. Which box?

board.do: Write the story in the box.

listen_for: No, she was not born in Kenya
misconceptions.ask: Aisha was born abroad. Her mother is a Kenyan citizen. Is Aisha a Kenyan citizen by birth?
misconceptions.repair: Use two stories: one born in Kenya, one born abroad to a Kenyan parent.

misconceptions.ask: What makes a person a citizen?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: is a baby a citizen? Does she have an ID?

misconceptions.ask: A foreign woman marries a Kenyan man. When can she apply for citizenship by registration?
misconceptions.repair: Tell the story with the years in order.

misconceptions.ask: A trader from another country has lived in Kenya for ten years. Is she now a Kenyan citizen?
misconceptions.repair: Read the rule: lawful residence for seven years lets a person apply to be registered.

checks.question: Name the two ways of becoming a Kenyan citizen.
Does getting an ID card make a person a citizen?
checks.answer: No, it shows they are a citizen

skills.key_step: The child says dual citizenship means being a citizen of Kenya and another country, that the 2010 Constitution allows it, and that a citizen by birth does not lose Kenyan citizenship.

floor.prerequisite: Says how a person becomes a citizen.
floor.question: How does a baby become a citizen of Kenya?
floor.answer: by birth to a Kenyan parent

representations: a story of a dual citizen
steps: Say what duties stay the same.
contexts: a Kenyan who also became a citizen of another country
a child born to a Kenyan and a Ugandan parent

board.do: Draw two flags joined by a plus sign.

board.say: What do we call being a citizen of both?

listen_for: No, Kenya does not allow it
misconceptions.ask: Can a Kenyan citizen also be a citizen of another country?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: what year is the Constitution?

misconceptions.ask: A Kenyan by birth takes the citizenship of another country. What happens to her Kenyan citizenship?
misconceptions.repair: Use a two-flag picture: two homes, one family.
Write county and country and say each with a map.

listen_for: No, they belong to another country too
misconceptions.ask: Does a dual citizen have to obey Kenya's laws?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens when a dual citizen drives in Nairobi.

checks.question: What is dual citizenship?
checks.answer: being a citizen of Kenya and another country at the same time

skills.key_step: The child picks actions of a good citizen and knows citizens have duties as well as rights.

floor.prerequisite: Says how a person becomes a citizen.
floor.question: Name one way to become a Kenyan citizen.

steps: Ask whether it helps the country.
contexts: a family planting trees on Mazingira Day

board.do: Draw a scale: rights on one side, duties on the other.

board.say: What duty goes with the right to a clean environment?

listen_for: Waiting until age 18 to do anything
misconceptions.ask: Which action shows good citizenship for a child?
misconceptions.repair: List things a ten-year-old can do for the school and the village.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a duty of a citizen?
misconceptions.repair: Pair every right with a duty in a two-column list.

misconceptions.ask: Can a Grade 5 learner be a good citizen?
misconceptions.repair: List what a learner did this week that helps the country.

misconceptions.ask: You see someone stealing a bicycle. What does a good citizen do?
misconceptions.repair: Discuss why only the police and courts decide punishment.

checks.question: Give two duties of a good citizen.
checks.answer: any two of: obey the law, respect others, keep the environment clean, take part in community work, vote when eligible, report wrongdoing
